nonblocking.title: Mutant V5 survives: api 'unknown' with a real base URL is not pinned
nonblocking.detail: I changed the last line of _runs_without_asking_auth to 'return api is None or api == "unknown" or api in apis' and all 200 #376 rows stayed GREEN. The case can be reached: an extension registers Model(id='corp-x', provider='corp', base_url='https://h.invalid/v1') with no api. On the tree that prompt is refused ('could not be resolved to a known API protocol'). Under V5 it is accepted, written, and fails at request time. The docs promise this case ('no adapter whatever its base URL, api unknown among them'). Every existing api-'unknown' row uses base_url '', so the base-URL arm refuses it first. This is the same masking as S8, but only for the sentinel. The fix is cheap: one turn_refusal row (or an RPC row) on that model.
